messages:
Maria (partnerships): Heads-up: finance needs partner billing primitives to finalize the Q3 cost model. Ask partners for precise proration and credit mechanics per SKU/region — we can't accept vague 'prorated' language.

Tom (partner-ops): Minimal capture fields: sku, region, commit_window_start, commit_window_end, reserve_pct_of_pool, phasing_kind, proration_unit (hour/day), billing_unit (per-hour/per-day/per-month), crediting_flow (instant_invoice_line/monthly_trueup/none), credit_lag_days, eviction_notice_minutes, latency_surcharge_flag.

Ryan (partner-eng): Add a field 'webhook_preempt_supported' and 'preempt_webhook_latency_sla_mins' so we can simulate failover cost when preemptions happen. Also 'apply_credit_on_preempt' (yes/no).

Kate (finance): Please include whether credits are netted on the same invoice or issued as a separate credit memo. For forecasting include 'cashflow_lag_days'.

Maria (partnerships): I'm attaching the sample CSV to send. Request one row per SKU/region combo. Ask partners to attach a representative invoice or a mockline if they use invoice_adjust.

```csv
sku,region,commit_window_start,commit_window_end,reserve_pct_of_pool,phasing_kind,proration_unit,billing_unit,crediting_flow,credit_lag_days,eviction_notice_minutes,latency_surcharge_flag,webhook_preempt_supported,apply_credit_on_preempt,notes
nebula-A100,us-west-2,2025-08-01,2026-07-31,60,linear,hour,per-hour,monthly_trueup,30,45,false,yes,yes,hourly proration; monthly true-up via account-level credit memo
volt-rtx6000,eu-west-1,2025-10-01,2026-03-31,100,step,day,per-day,instant_invoice_line,0,60,true,no,no,commit cliffs at quarter boundaries
```

Alex (vendor-liaison): I'll request fills. Note: one partner (EdgeCloud) will only provide percent-of-pool and a contract PDF; they refuse per-SKU splits. We'll need a fallback rule.

Tom (partner-ops): Fallback assumptions for modeling if partner data missing: reserve_pct_of_pool=100, proration_unit=day, billing_unit=per-day, crediting_flow=monthly_trueup, credit_lag_days=30, eviction_notice_minutes=0, webhook_preempt_supported=no. Label these rows as 'assumed_defaults'.

Kate (finance): Also log 'contractual_non_prorate' if partner has no pro rata on early termination. That creates a commit-cliff we must model as a burn schedule.

Ryan (partner-eng): For partners that provide 'custom' phasing_kind, ask for an explicit month-by-month percent CSV column or attach a small schedule. We can't interpret 'phased over time' without numbers.

Maria (partnerships): Action items: Alex collect 3 example fills (one hourly true-up, one instant invoice adjust, one partial pool-only PDF) by Friday EOD. Tom to implement parsing rules for enums and tag assumed defaults. Kate to adjust forecast cashflow for credit_lag_days.

deploy-bot: created tracker: https://internal.redwood/drive/PartnerBillingPrimitives (access: partnerships, finance, partner-ops) :spiral_note-pad:

Alex (vendor-liaison): Will update thread when responses come in. Thanks. :thumbsup:
